ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 80% low-intensity (dark) pixels with 20% high-intensity (white) pixel clusters distributed across the surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dark base layer punctuated by discrete high-contrast white circular and annular geometric spots (ranging from 2 to 10 pixels in diameter) scattered across both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep U-shaped depression with a central interior angle of approximately 60 degrees and a vertical depth comprising roughly 15% of the total fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Frequent low-amplitude serrations along the trailing edge with significant macro-level jaggedness and protruding clusters at the distal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetric convex curves along the trailing edge of both lobes terminating in sharp, upward-oriented distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense concentration of high-contrast white annular rings (circular pixel clusters) across the lateral and medial regions of both lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Structural deformity at both distal tips characterized by highly irregular, lumpy high-intensity pixel masses.
other_distinctive_markers: Embedded alphanumeric metadata overlay at the bottom: 'GS 25/ 25 10150 GRETCHEN STEIGER 7 Oct 87'.
